text:
lina: opened a PR to unify the function/tool calling examples + parsing guardrails. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001

chris (eng): Nice. main ask: can we show both a strict jsonschema example and a tolerant one for older clients?

noah (sdk): yes — canonical schema strict, plus an SDK shim example that accepts nullable fields and maps to camelCase. I'll add a unit test if you want.

lina: please. also found one stray link to the old `tool-caller.md` in the migration guide that needs updating.

maya (support): FYI customers have been tripping on the `args` shape mismatch. a short migration note for support would help.

noah (sdk): proposed schema (language-agnostic):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": { "type": "string" },
    "args": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true },
    "request_id": { "type": "string" }
  },
  "required": ["action", "request_id"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

noah (sdk): and SDK-level example (JS-friendly):

```js
// receive raw response
const raw = await client.generate({ model: 'text-parse-v2', parse: true });
// sdk shim to handle older shapes
const parsed = parseResponse(raw) || {};
const action = parsed.action || parsed.action_name || 'noop';
const requestId = parsed.requestId || parsed.request_id || 'unknown';
return { action, args: parsed.args || {}, requestId };
```

chris (eng): love the shim. can we include a tiny snippet about `parsingConfidence` so callers can decide to fallback? e.g., float 0-1.

lina: added a brief guardrail: "If confidence < 0.6, treat output as untrusted and run a deterministic fallback."

maya (support): Suggest wording: "untrusted outputs may return `parsingConfidence: 0` and `action: 'noop'` to indicate safe failure."

noah (sdk): I'll update the SDK to map `parsing_confidence` -> `parsingConfidence` and emit that in the shim. also adding tests for confidence thresholds.

lina: legal check : just make sure examples don't include real-looking PII. replaced email/example names with placeholders.

chris (eng): small perf note in the doc: recommend `kv_cache: true` for v2 when sequence lengths < 1k; add routing fallback sample: prefer `parse-v2` -> fallback `parse-compat` with `kv_cache:false`.

lina: added both routing sample and a one-line migration checklist for docs readers.

ops-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/9001/index.html#parse-guardrails

noah (sdk): PR opened for sdk-examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/415 9 tests included.

maya (support): I'll draft a 2-sentence blurb for the support portal and link the docs preview.

lina: editorial nit: prefer `parsingConfidence` in prose when talking about SDK behavior; keep snake_case only in schema block. changed that.

chris (eng): looks good. one more: add a short line about logging: include `request_id` in trace logs for correlation.

lina: done. merging in 10 if no objections. anyone want review?

noah (sdk): reviewing now, will add the mapping test.

maya (support): approved.

lina: merged and live. thanks all :rocket:

ops-bot: docs site updated: https://deploy.redwood-inference/docs/parse-guardrails#overview"
